evidence.text: Mil's Cafe Home About Us Menu Services Careers Contact Welcome to Meal --> Reserve A Table --> Mil's Café Find your best Breakfast and Lunch. Open daily 7am to 3pm. Breakfast served all day. Lunch starts at 10am. Join Our Team! We're Hiring! Send us your resume today! Learn More Breakfast & Lunch! Check Out Our Menu! Check out our menu, we have flavors and foods for all, even a kids menu! Learn More Contact Us! Send Us An Email! Questions, comments, or concerns? Email us today! Learn More About The Café Mil’s Café was born from over 40 years of experience in the restaurant industry — and a lifelong love of food that started at my mom’s kitchen table. Growing up, my mom had a special way of making everyone feel welcome, always gathering family and friends around delicious home-cooked meals. Those moments left a lasting impression on me. At Mil’s Café, I’ve carried that same spirit forward. Every dish we serve is inspired by the warmth, friendship, and love that filled my mom’s kitchen. When you join us at Mil’s, you’re not just a guest — you’re part of the family. Menu Breakfast and Lunch! Breakfast served all day. Lunch starts at 10am. --> Breakfast Lunch Treats & Beverages Kids PANCAKES, FRENCH TOAST, & WAFFLES --> Classic Pancakes Three Fluffy Ricotta pancakes. --> Blueberry Pancakes Three fluffy Ricotta pancakes with fresh blueberries cooked right in the pancakes and topped with Blueberry-Lemon Ricotta filling, dusted with powder sugar. --> Chocolate Chip Pancakes Three fluffy Ricotta pancakes with chocolate chips cooked right in the pancakes and topped with whipped cream. --> French Toast Thick cut Brioche bread slices dipped in our special egg batter, dusted with powdered sugar, topped with butter, and served with maple syrup. *Add a topping. --> Stuffed French Toast Thick cut Brioche bread filled with Blueberry-Lemon Ricotta filling dipped in our special egg batter, grilled to perfection and topped with more Blueberries, dusted with powder sugar. --> Stuffed Nutella French Toast Thick cut Brioche bread filled with Nutella filling with sliced bananas dipped in our special egg batter, grilled to perfection and topped with more sliced bananas. --> Belgian Waffle Served with butter and maple syrup. *Add a topping. --> Toppings - Raspberry & whipped cream. - Strawberry Topping & whipped cream. - Blueberry-Lemon Ricotta filling CLASSICS --> Classic Breakfast Two eggs, Hashbrown Potatoes and your choice of toast, or fluffy Ricotta pancakes. --> Steak & Eggs New York Strip cooked to order with two eggs any style. --> Irish Eggs Benedict Two poached eggs, served on a toasted English muffin topped with shaved corn beef, with a creamy hollandaise sauce over the top. Served with hashbrown Potatoes. --> Country Fried Steak Crispy country fried steak covered in country gravy, two eggs any style. --> Biscuits & Gravy Two fresh baked buttermilk biscuits smothered in Italian style Country gravy. Served with hashbrown Potatoes. --> Breakfast Burrito A warm soft flour tortilla filled with scrambled eggs, and hash browns. Topped with homemade Chili Verde and cheddar cheese. OMELETS & SKILLETS Three Egg Omelet served with hashbrown Potatoes and your choice of toast, or fluffy Ricotta pancakes. --> Create Your Own Omelet Start with a cheese omelet and choose from the following items: Mushrooms, onions, green peppers, olives, tomatoes, spinach, extra cheese. Bacon, sausage, or ham. --> Create Your Own Skillet Home fried potatoes mixed with your choice of bacon sausage or ham, and any three veggies. BURGERS & CHICKEN --> 6oz. Wagyu Burger House burger sauce, lettuce, tomato, mayo, red onion, and pickles. --> Grilled Terriyaki Chicken Teriyaki marinated chicken breast, deli ham, Pepperjack cheese with grilled pineapple topped with mayo, lettuce, and tomato. --> BBQ Chicken BBQ sauce marinated chicken breast melted cheddar cheese with mayo, lettuce, tomato, and topped onion straws. SANDWICHES & SUCH --> Grilled Ham & Cheese Melt The ultimate four cheese & ham grilled to perfection on sourdough bread. --> Classic Club Roasted turkey and bacon, with mayo, lettuce, and tomatoes. Served on Sourdough. --> Monte Cristo Ham & Gruyere cheese on Sourdough bread dipped in an egg batter & grilled until golden brown. Dusted with powdered sugar & served with raspberry jelly for dipping. --> Classic Reuben Sandwich Corned beef piled high with sauerkraut, Swiss cheese, and Russian dressing on grilled marble rye. --> Chicken Tenders Golden fried tenders served with fries and Texas Toast. --> Fish 'N' Chips Hand dipped in Tempura batter and fried to golden brown, served with fries. SALADS & PASTAS --> BBQ Chicken Salad A bed of mixed greens with tomatoes, House BBQ sauce marinated chicken breast, avocado, black beans, and topped with onion straws with your choice of dressing. --> Cilantro Lime Chicken Taco Salad Tender, juicy chicken with tomatoes, black beans, sweet corn, shredded cheddar cheese, & avocado. Including crunchy, salty tortilla chips & zesty, sweet & the tangy Creamy Baja Catalina Dressing. --> Cobb Salad Grilled chicken breast, hardwood-smoked bacon, fresh avocado, bleu cheese crumbles, hard-boiled eggs, tomato and croutons on mixed greens with your choice of dressing. --> Spicy Chicken Chipotle Pasta Spicy Chicken Chipotle Penne Pasta with asparagus, onions, and bell peppers. --> Lorenzo’s Penne Pasta Italian sausage, onions, and bell peppers in a creamy vodka sauce with Penne Pasta. SWEET TREATS --> Cinnamon Roll Our ooey, gooey, fluffy cinnamon roll is combined with indulgent sweet cinnamon and rich frosting. BEVERAGES --> Coke Products & Iced Tea Coke, Diet Coke, Sprite, Root Beer, Mountain Dew, Dr. Pepper, Diet Dr. Pepper, Minute Made Lemonade, Iced Tea. --> Coffee Regular or Decaf. --> Hot Chocolate --> Juices Orange, Apple, or Cranberry. --> Milk --> Pancakes One pancake, egg, and bacon or sausage. --> Eggs Eggs with Bacon or Sausage & potatoes and toast. --> Cheeseburger Cheeseburger with or without
